headline: 220 hospitalized in 24hrs as 2 more die of dengue
summary: The death toll for the year has reached 9, with 220 new admissions in a single day according to the Directorate General of Health Services.
details: Two women, aged between 26 and 35, died from dengue in the last 24 hours. One death occurred in the Barishal division and the other in a hospital within the Dhaka South City Corporation area.

headline: 680 children die as measles death toll rises in Bangladesh
summary: Three more children died within 24 hours, bringing the total number of confirmed and suspected measles-related deaths to 680, according to the DGHS.
details: Three more children died with symptoms consistent with measles in 24 hours, taking the country's combined tally of confirmed and suspected deaths to 680.
According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), 587 of these deaths are suspected and 93 are laboratory-confirmed.
The crisis is escalating rapidly, with 1,001 new suspected cases reported in a single day, bringing the nationwide total to 92,790.
Additionally, 62 new laboratory-confirmed cases were recorded in the last 24 hours, raising the total number of confirmed infections to 11,011.
Since March 15, a total of 76,859 patients with suspected measles have been hospitalized across the country.
Of those hospitalized, 72,849 patients have recovered, according to DGHS data.
caption:
680 children dead. Over 92,000 suspected cases. A measles crisis is gripping Bangladesh.

Three more children died with symptoms consistent with measles in 24 hours, taking the country's combined tally of confirmed and suspected deaths to 680.

According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), 587 of these deaths are suspected and 93 are laboratory-confirmed.

The crisis is escalating rapidly, with 1,001 new suspected cases reported in a single day, bringing the nationwide total to 92,790.

Additionally, 62 new laboratory-confirmed cases were recorded in the last 24 hours, raising the total number of confirmed infections to 11,011.

Since March 15, a total of 76,859 patients with suspected measles have been hospitalized across the country.

Of those hospitalized, 72,849 patients have recovered, according to DGHS data.

#Bangladesh #HealthCrisis #Measles #PublicHealth #DGHS #ChildHealth

Source: The Daily Star, bdnews24.com, Dhaka Tribune, Somoy News
